var lastOutcome = $('CODE | Process Cloudinary Upload Outcome').last().json;
return [{ json: { _loop: lastOutcome._loop } }];

function safeSlug(v) { return String(v || '').replace(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, '_').slice(0, 48); }
var req = $('CODE | Validate & Safeguard').first().json;
var inp = $input.first().json || {};
var state = inp._loop || inp;
var failed = inp.dl_ok === false || inp.up_ready === false || inp.upload_failed === true || !Array.isArray(state.uploadedAssets) || !state.uploadedAssets.length || state.uploadedAssets.length !== (state.items || []).length;
var assets = Array.isArray(state.uploadedAssets) ? state.uploadedAssets : [];
var meta = state.metadata || {};
var nowIso = new Date().toISOString();

var postPatch = failed
  ? {
      status: 'FAILED',
      error: String(inp.errMsg || 'Extraction failed').slice(0, 500),
      error_code: String(inp.errCode || 'EXTRACTION_FAILED'),
      error_stage: String(inp.errStage || 'EXTRACTION')
    }
  : {
      status: 'DRAFT',
      media_url: assets[0].secure_url,
      media_type: assets.length > 1 ? 'CAROUSEL' : (assets[0].media_type === 'IMAGE' ? 'IMAGE' : 'REEL'),
      original_caption: meta.original_caption || '',
      caption: meta.caption || '',
      caption_status: meta.caption_status || 'unknown',
      caption_source: meta.caption_source || 'none',
      canonical_url: meta.canonical_url || req.source_instagram_url,
      source_id: state.sourceId || '',
      source_username: meta.source_username || '',
      source_kind: meta.source_kind || '',
      hashtags: meta.hashtags || [],
      mentions: meta.mentions || [],
      media_count: assets.length,
      image_count: Number(state.imgCount || 0),
      video_count: Number(state.vidCount || 0),
      source_published_at: meta.source_published_at || '',
      source_like_count: meta.source_like_count !== undefined ? meta.source_like_count : '',
      source_comment_count: meta.source_comment_count !== undefined ? meta.source_comment_count : '',
      source_play_count: meta.source_play_count !== undefined ? meta.source_play_count : '',
      source_metadata: meta.source_metadata || {},
      file_size_bytes: Number(state.totalBytes || 0),
      extracted_at: nowIso,
      uploaded_at: nowIso,
      error: '',
      error_code: '',
      error_stage: ''
    };

var logId = 'log_' + Date.now() + '_' + safeSlug(req.post_id);
var execLog = {
  log_id: logId,
  request_id: req.request_id,
  execution_id: req.execution_id,
  workflow_id: 'w01-extract',
  workflow_name: 'W01 Extract & Upload',
  post_id: req.post_id,
  operation: 'EXTRACT',
  trigger_source: 'DASHBOARD',
  stage: failed ? (inp.errStage || 'FAILED') : 'COMPLETED',
  status: failed ? 'FAILED' : 'SUCCESS',
  started_at: req.started_at,
  finished_at: nowIso,
  duration_ms: Math.max(0, Date.now() - Date.parse(req.started_at || nowIso)),
  error_code: failed ? String(inp.errCode || 'EXTRACTION_FAILED') : '',
  error_message: failed ? String(inp.errMsg || '') : '',
  retryable: failed,
  created_at: nowIso
};

return [{
  json: {
    rpc_body: {
      p_post_uuid: req.post_uuid,
      p_post_patch: postPatch,
      p_assets: assets,
      p_job_id: req.job_id || '',
      p_request_id: req.request_id || '',
      p_execution_id: req.execution_id || '',
      p_lock_key: req.lock_key,
      p_lock_owner: req.worker_owner
    },
    exec_log: execLog,
    sync_row: {
      entity_type: 'EXECUTION_LOG',
      entity_uuid: req.post_uuid,
      external_id: logId,
      operation: 'UPSERT',
      payload: execLog,
      idempotency_key: 'log:w01:' + req.post_uuid + ':' + (req.request_id || Date.now()),
      status: 'PENDING'
    }
  }
}];
